_readme: Sponsor display settings for the live donor wall on sponsors.html.
Keys under "sponsors" match the donor name exactly as it appears on the Hack Club Bank ledger (case does not matter).
display: name shown on the site. logo: image path under assets/img/sponsors/. url: website linked from the name.
tier: force Supporter, Partner, Builder, or Champion, for example an in-kind sponsor whose gifts do not match the amount.
hide: true removes the donor from the wall.
